smallCamps.notes: Each wilderness generation rolls 2-4 persistent little camps independently on every wilderness map. These camps contain procedural Porakaneki only and do not migrate with the chief.

chiefCamp.notes: Exactly one large chief camp is active worldwide. Its site changes wilderness map whenever the regional season changes; inactive maps retain only an internal placement reservation so their little camps never need to be reshuffled.

avengers.notes: Porakaneki Avengers: the Porakaneki mean to wipe out the Omgurku, who normally escape trouble by outrunning it; the Avengers ride Nazgraku so they cannot. One band lives at the first hunting camp of every wilderness map. It patrols around home and rides down any Omgurku hunter travelling at least travellerMinDistanceTiles from its own camp within seekRadiusTiles, with no daily limit (killsPerDay > 0 sets one). A band only rides at a group no larger than itself (living Omgurku within groupRadiusTiles of the quarry); if the group outnumbers it, on screen or off, it breaks off and rides home to regroup for retreatHours, so Omgurku are safest travelling together and the Avengers prey on stragglers. Off-screen catches are a contest: riderLossChance the cornered quarry kills one rider and gets away, quarryEscapeChance it outruns the mounts anyway, otherwise it dies. An escaped quarry is left alone for escapeReprieveHours of game time. Off-screen victims, Omgurku and riders alike, are replaced in their camp after behavior.slainReplacementDays (default 2). Near the player the riders fight it out through the shared rival-tribe ecology.
